question: How is the river Sindhu prayed to act against the fuel of evil deeds?
premises: Sindhu is addressed as a destroyer
Evil deeds are figured as fuel
The prayer asks Sindhu to act upon that fuel
inference: Sindhu is prayed to become the destroyer of the fuel of evil deeds.
uncertainties: kanduḥ may carry the sense of itching or burning; taken here as destroyer
plain_english: May Sindhu be the destroyer of the fuel of evil deeds.
